title: Presentation Pdf Cover Fit
description: Fix PDF disposition rendering: must cover frame like figures (uniform scale, centered, no distortion). Issues: wide PDFs keep fixed height with side gaps; narrow PDFs squeeze horizontally.
summary:
Fixed PDF dispositions not covering their frame (letterboxing when wide, horizontal squeeze when narrow).

Root cause: react-pdf `Page` used fixed `height` only (fit-height), and CSS `max-width`/`max-height` on the canvas squeezed pages wider than the frame.

Fix: `pdfCoverScale()` computes uniform cover scale from container and page viewport; `PdfMorphView` renders with `scale={coverScale}` after `onLoadSuccess`. Removed canvas max-size constraints; parent frame clips and centers via existing flex + overflow hidden.

79 renderer tests pass.
